title: English Practice Quiz 0046
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The work ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: If a task is 'urgent', it needs ___.
questions.explanation: Urgent means requiring immediate or prompt attention.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.
